candidates.title: Draft an invoice register for review

demandEvidence.chore: Handle invoices and time reports, follow up customers, and report key figures to the owner.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Hantera ekonomi och tidsrapportera– sköta fakturering, följa upp kunder och rapportera nyckeltal till ägaren

ease.reason: The attached template describes extracting invoice fields into a sheet; field accuracy still needs manual checks.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: small professional offices may value invoice entry; no AI service buyers are evidenced.

feasibility.reason: A synthetic PDF to draft-register prototype fits two weeks; private records and accounting integrations are excluded.

autonomy.reason: Extraction and row drafting can repeat, but a person must verify amounts and approve accounting actions.

evidence.reason: The vacancy names invoicing; two template listings describe extraction and spreadsheet logging, not accuracy or use.

candidates.reason: Below the threshold: the bounded invoice-register experiment has limited template support, and the source does not specify its accounting rules.

candidates.title: Prepare a records filing checklist

ease.reason: A mock checklist is possible, but no attached reference supports records filing mechanics.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: offices may value help organizing records; AI-service demand is unproved.

feasibility.reason: A fictional register can be mocked, but filing rules and required fields are absent from evidence.

autonomy.reason: A person must classify records and approve filing; no relevant automation reference is attached.

evidence.reason: The paid notice explicitly names registration, diarization, and archiving, without process detail.

candidates.reason: Below the threshold: the chore is concrete, but filing rules are unspecified and no attached building reference supports a useful autonomous loop.

candidates.title: Sort shared-car-pool support requests

demandEvidence.chore: Handle the booking system and customer support for the municipality’s shared car pool.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Vi har även hand om bokningssystem och kundsupport för kommunens gemensamma bilpool

ease.reason: The notice names booking and customer support, but no attached reference supports these system mechanics.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a public-service office may value less repetitive support work; AI-service demand is not shown.

feasibility.reason: A mock could classify fictional messages, but booking rules and system access are unspecified.

autonomy.reason: Any booking change or customer response needs staff review; no relevant implementation evidence is attached.

evidence.reason: The paid notice names shared-car-pool bookings and support, but gives no task detail or software evidence.

candidates.reason: Duplicate workflow: support-request handling overlaps recent post 98b4f6281cc3de4ecdfa95f6 (“support inbox”), so reject regardless of the different service.

rejected.title: Paid administrator role — broad communications and varied duties
rejected.reason: The notice describes a central administrative role, creative communications, and highly variable duties, but gives no concrete task to design a bounded experiment around; do not infer duties from the job title.

rejected.title: Paid administrator role — task details absent
rejected.reason: The fresh notice contains no task excerpt beyond the generic paid-role disclaimer, so there is no concrete chore to assess without inventing duties.

rejected.title: Draft an invoice register for review
rejected.reason: Below threshold after assessing a bounded invoice-register experiment; the vacancy does not specify accounting rules or establish AI-service buyers.

rejected.title: Prepare a records filing checklist
rejected.reason: Below threshold: the chore is explicit, but filing rules and relevant implementation evidence are absent.

rejected.title: Sort shared-car-pool support requests
rejected.reason: Duplicate workflow: handling customer-support requests overlaps recent post 98b4f6281cc3de4ecdfa95f6, even though the customer and product differ.

steps.message: Assessed the three selected notices with concrete chores; all are below threshold or duplicate a recent support-inbox workflow. The two remaining notices lack task evidence. No post proposed.
